title: Give the Mark III tap-shaped actions on the full table, and measure which rows a week reaches
tier_reason: Brain code behind the unit suite, the demo's gate and the replay round-trip; git reverts it. The table is ruled; the honesty of the measurement is the deliverable.
ask: WI-9b in docs/V0_2_1_PLAN.md: eight actions (till, plant, water, harvest, ship, shoo, wander, wait), each executed as her tap is — walk to the nearest legal tile in view, do the verb — with the router's legality; reward from the pre-state; plant and sell cues in farm.gd; the harness with crows, ripe crops and a seeded box; the gate restored to an assertion; a per-row report of what the linear learner reaches in a week.
source_message: CEO on Q-100, 2026-09-09, chief of staff session: the full reward table.
result: Landed on main (commit f2c1758 merged): eight tap-shaped actions with errand walking, reward from the pre-state, plant and sell cues (puff only, because her own are silent), the harness with crows, ripe crops and a seeded box, the gate restored as an assertion. Fixed seed: days 1-3 average 9.7 points, days 5-7 18.1; day 4 shipped a crop for 10. 24 farms, days 5-7, learning against control per row: shipped 5.56/0.97, harvested 0.58/0.10, watered_plant 7.81/6.11, planted 9.14/8.94, tilled 0.83/0.96, watered_soil 0.29/0.42, crows 0/0 on both rows. Gate: 8 farms 19.8 against 18.2, 6 of 8 rose; 24 farms 24.2 against 17.5, 20 of 24. LEARN_RATE 0.03 from a sweep (0.12 ends below the control). Unit 2425, integration 671, robot session and gateway green. Chief of staff verified on main after the merge.
